note: Untreated wood products. The sheet never says whether the product is a substance or a mixture, so the product form is UNDETERMINED and the conditional identifier fields stay NOT_STATED rather than being ruled out by the ontology. Section 9 uses the abbreviations NAP (not applicable) and NAV (not available), which the state cue table has to distinguish.
